# Heteroscedasticity diagnostic theme

<small>Source: [`R/ggplot_extensions.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/ggplot_extensions.R) · Help: `?theme_hetero`</small>

Applies a light-minimal theme with subtle gridlines and bold titles to
maintain visual consistency across diagnostic plots.

## Usage

```r
theme_hetero(base_size = 12, base_family = "")
```

## Arguments

`base_size`
:   Base font size.

`base_family`
:   Base font family.

## Value

A [ggplot2::theme](https://rdrr.io/cran/ggplot2/man/theme.html) object.

## Examples

```r
theme_hetero()
```
